title: /reports/[id]
responsibility: Redirects a former report address to the console, which opens the explorer where that report belongs.

inputs.name: load.params
inputs.description: The legacy report identifier to carry into the console address.

outputs.name: load
outputs.description: Does not return; throws the permanent redirect to the report address in the explorer.

errors.name: URIError
errors.description: A report identifier containing an unpaired UTF-16 surrogate cannot be URL encoded.
